question.text: Which of the following atoms has the highest first ionization energy?

solution.text: Due to poor shielding of d-electrons in Sc, <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow></msub></math> of Sc becomes more so that ionisation energy of Sc is more than Na, K and Rb.
